title: A goal call restored after evaluation
summary: The optional reviewer rejected a supported “Kane scores!” draft. Disabling it restored the caller’s reaction and a later analyst response in this development pair.
scope: Same 20-second clip, same model, identical visual evidence and research. Both outputs are unedited. This focused comparison followed the 15-clip pilot.

clip.title: England vs France — first attempt
clip.subtitle: Reviewer enabled
clip.note: First attempt in the bounded demo polish, with the optional reviewer enabled. Exact generated words on saved perception; prepared before playback.

lines.text: Penalty England! The referee points straight to the spot
Kane sends the keeper the wrong way and slots it low into the left corner, a composed penalty finish.

method: Same saved perception, resolved identities and dated squad context as the selected after run.
The optional reviewer rejects the caller’s supported goal draft twice.
The caller’s goal turn is dropped; the analyst announces the finish instead.
Exact generated words are retained. No voice synthesis or manual script rewrite.

observations.description: An England attacker drives into the France box on the ground and is challenged by two defenders, with one sliding in from the side as the ball stays near the attacker's feet.
The referee points toward the penalty spot after the challenge in the area, while players around the incident appeal with raised arms.
England's number 9 begins the penalty kick run-up from the spot with the referee beside the area and France's goalkeeper set on the goal line.
The penalty is struck low into the left side of the goal as the goalkeeper dives the other way and the ball crosses the line into the net.
England's number 9 runs away along the byline with arms out in celebration after scoring.
Replay: England's number 9 strikes the penalty with his right foot from the spot.
Replay: the ball rises into the goal after the penalty, visibly inside the net.

turns.detail: Supported immediate action is an England dribble into the France box under challenge.
